title: How often should I service my AC in Al Warqa?
desc: For many residential systems, servicing every 3 to 6 months is suitable. Heavily used AC units may need more frequent checks.

title: Why is my AC taking too long to cool?
desc: Common reasons include dirty filters, low refrigerant, blocked coils, restricted airflow or thermostat problems. An inspection can identify the exact cause.

title: How much does AC repair cost in Al Warqa?
desc: The cost depends on the AC type, fault, required parts and repair work. An inspection helps determine the actual repair needed.

title: Can you fix AC water leakage?
desc:
Yes, we fix water leakage of AC units; these common causes include:
  • Blocked drain line
  • Frozen evaporator coil
  • Dirty filter
  • Drainage problems

title: When does an AC need refrigerant refill?
desc: Low refrigerant may require a refill, but the system should first be checked for a possible refrigerant leak.

title: Does AC cleaning remove bad smells?
desc: Yes. Cleaning filters, coils and drainage areas can remove dust, moisture and buildup that often cause unpleasant AC odors.

title: Is same-day AC repair available in Al Warqa?
desc: Same-day AC repair may be available depending on technician schedules, location and the type of AC fault.

title: What does AC maintenance include?
desc:
A maintenance visit may include:
  • Filter cleaning
  • Coil inspection
  • Drain line checking
  • Thermostat testing
  • Cooling performance testing

title: Which AC brands do you repair?
desc: We service major brands including Daikin, LG, Samsung, Carrier, Mitsubishi, O General, York, Gree, Panasonic and other common AC brands.

title: Why is my AC making a buzzing noise?
desc: Buzzing can result from loose electrical parts, fan problems, vibration or worn components. An inspection can locate the source.

title: How can I reduce my AC electricity bill?
desc: Keep filters clean, maintain clear airflow, avoid very low thermostat settings and arrange routine AC maintenance to keep the system efficient.

title: Is an Annual Maintenance Contract worth it?
desc: An AMC provides scheduled servicing and preventive checks. It can help identify developing faults earlier and reduce unexpected repair needs.

title: Why is one room colder than another?
desc: Uneven cooling may result from blocked filters, duct restrictions, poor airflow, thermostat settings or an issue with the cooling system.

title: Should I repair or replace an old AC?
desc: Repair can be practical for smaller faults. Replacement may make more sense when an older unit has repeated failures or major repair costs.

title: How can I book AC service in Al Warqa?
desc: Share your Al Warqa location, AC problem and preferred service time with FAJ Technical Services L.L.C our team can arrange a suitable appointment.
